modules.responsibility: 站点、周期、流向和可驶航道
航图、行动预览和本地恢复

workflows.name: 开局航图
workflows.success: 显示站点、六刻潮表和可用航道
workflows.failure: 不存在的航次入口返回 404
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const a=briefing(c,[]); if(!a.options.some(x=>x.available)||a.calendar.length!==6)process.exit(1); console.log(a.course.name);'
steps: 从 GET briefing 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，显示站点、六刻潮表和可用航道

workflows.name: 整段潮窗
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const a=briefing(c,[go("west"),k("tune"),go("north")]); if(a.rejected?.code!=="tide"||a.state.tick!==3)process.exit(1); console.log(a.rejected.message);'
steps: 从 POST replay 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，顺利入站并扣减电量

workflows.name: 补给
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const a=briefing(c,[go("creek"),go("creek"),k("charge")]); if(a.rejected||a.state.power!==10||a.state.tick!==5)process.exit(1); console.log(a.state.power);'
steps: 从 POST replay 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，靠岸补电且不上溢

workflows.name: 校准
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const a=briefing(c,[go("west"),k("tune"),k("tune")]); if(a.rejected?.code!=="beacon"||a.score.signal!==2)process.exit(1); console.log(a.score.signal);'
steps: 从 POST replay 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，首次校准计分

workflows.name: 返港结算
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const a=briefing(c,[go("west"),k("tune"),k("wait"),go("crossing"),k("tune"),go("creek"),k("finish")]); if(!a.score.won||a.state.tick!==9||a.score.points!==98)process.exit(1); console.log(a.score.points);'
steps: 从 POST replay 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，返港后得到成绩

workflows.name: 记录回放
workflows.success: 指令重放恢复相同状态
workflows.failure: 非法指令保留拒绝前状态
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReach as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach.mjs"; import {briefing} from "./server/voyage/briefing.mjs"; const go=lane=>({kind:"sail",lane}); const k=kind=>({kind}); const data=[go("west"),k("tune"),k("wait"),go("crossing"),k("tune"),go("creek"),k("finish")]; if(JSON.stringify(briefing(c,data))!==JSON.stringify(briefing(c,JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data)))))process.exit(1); console.log(data.length);'
steps: 从 POST replay 解析业务输入
应用领域状态与边界，指令重放恢复相同状态

workflows.name: 专项收发联调计分
workflows.success: 交班当刻按开放航道与一发一收取最高链路组合计分
workflows.failure: 闭潮当刻链路剔除、未达标计零
workflows.verification: node --input-type=module -e 'import {outerReachSpecial as c} from "./server/course/outer-reach-special.mjs"; import {score} from "./server/voyage/score.mjs"; const st=(tick,sigs,p=1)=>({tick,at:"dock",power:p,lit:[],signals:sigs,status:"returned",log:[]}); const a=score(c,st(14,{shoal:"receive",skerry:"send",reed:"receive"})); const full={reed:"send",foam:"receive",shoal:"send",skerry:"receive"}; const b=score(c,st(24,full)),d=score(c,st(26,full)),e=score(c,st(27,full)); if(a.signal!==4||a.points!==107||b.points!==87||d.points!==123||e.points!==121||d.signal!==6)process.exit(1); console.log(a.points,b.points,d.points,e.points);'
steps: 在同一外湾航图上以 27 刻专项期限重放收发设置与改频
按交班当刻潮窗与一发一收约束做每标至多一条的最大权链路匹配

workflows.name: 专项规则全程复演
workflows.success: 实录锚点、合法重放、链路匹配与旧 18 刻规则全部通过
workflows.failure: 任一规则断言失败即非零退出
steps: 复演需求三段实录的链路点数与得分锚点
核验收发设置、改频、自动结班、记录还原及夜班旧规则

mechanisms: 多班次航图复用与模式切换
收发设置与同代价改频
交班当刻链路开放判定
每标至多一条的最大权链路匹配
